product_metadata.title: iPEGTOP L-4C Strong Suction Cup Adhesive Shower Caddy Bath Shelf Storage with 4 Side Hooks, Combo Organizer Basket for Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap, Razor Bathroom Accessories, Chrome

Multi-functional and Modern Design: Drain design, long enough and best to store and organize bath accessories, wash supplies, kitchen gadgets, decoration items, etc
Bold stainless steel, super strong vacuum suction load capacity - up to 8 kg; Dimensions - 15 inch x 5-1/2 inch x 2-2/5 inch
